Subject: Planning: 409A blackout windows + award release cadence for upcoming hires

Stephanie / Laura —

Putting this on your radars as hiring velocity ramps for Q3. We have three offers in the pipe that want equity effective dates aligned with the next board approval window. Finance/legal asked for a clear schedule so they can prepare issuance and tax reporting.

Key items:
- Proposed board approval date: week of 7/19 (we have a tentative slot; see attached calendar).
- Planned award release day (post-board signoff + 409A effective date): target 7/27 so we can do payroll/tax withholding matrix for next cycle.
- 409A blackout: recommend a 10-day freeze (7/20–7/30) where we do not accept any equity-related changes to offers/refreshes that would affect FMV.

Ask: Can legal confirm downstream steps (DocuSign, stock ledger entry) and Finance confirm cashless-exercise/tax timing? Also, Laura — can you prioritize candidate communications so offer acceptances don't fall into the blackout?

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few quick notes:

- I don’t want the blackout to block verbal offers; it should only prevent changes to equity amounts or pricing after the 409A effective date. We need to be explicit in the candidate comms.
- Can we compress to a 7-day blackout (7/23–7/29) if legal confirms that’s sufficient for issuing? Shorter window reduces hiring risk.
- Laura, please include the roadmap for when offers must be signed to be included in this issuance (we need a hard cutoff).

If legal is comfortable with a 7-day freeze I’ll lock the comms and ask TA to get signatures out this week.

— Stephanie

Subject: Re: Planning: 409A blackout windows + award release cadence for upcoming hires

Agree with a compressed window but want to flag a couple of finance constraints:

- We need at least 48 business hours after the board signoff to finalize the cap table delta and issue stock certificates/entry in Carta. That pushes any earliest release to 7/21 if board signs on 7/19.
- Tax withholding for RSUs vs options differs; for options exercised at grant we need the candidate to complete tax forms prior to release. Payroll cutoff for August processing is 7/30.
- Cashless exercise liquidity: if any hires are outside the US we may need local counsel clearance which could add 5–7 business days.

I’ve attached our memo summarizing the 409A opinion assumptions and the time estimates for downstream ops. If we compress to a 7-day blackout, legal must confirm that the opinion and execution timelines are unaffected.

Attachment: 409a-opinion-summary.pdf

— Vivek
Director, Finance Ops (Comp & Equity)
Redwood Inference

From: Maggie Lang <maggie@worklawpartners.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: 409A blackout windows + award release cadence for upcoming hires

Stephanie —

Quick legal read: a 7-day blackout is acceptable provided the following are met:
1) Board passes a clean resolution with the grant amounts tied to an existing equity plan and the resolution is executed immediately.
2) The company’s 409A report must include the valuation effective date (the board meeting date) and we should not make offer changes that would materially affect FMV between that meeting and issuance.
3) For international hires, include a clause that awards are subject to local counsel clearance; that keeps the US blackout from unintentionally delaying local-required filings.

I recommend the following final schedule to minimize risk:
- Board meeting: 2026-07-22 (finalized)
- 409A effective date: 2026-07-22
- Blackout window: 2026-07-22 — 2026-07-29 (inclusive)
- Target issuance/ledger entry: 2026-07-30

I’ll prepare a short DocuSign flow and resolution template. Send me the list of awardees and share the board materials link.

— Maggie Lang
WorkLaw Partners (equity & benefits practice)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

  - Target issuance/ledger entry: 2026-09-16

Action items (owners):

- Laura: prepare final roster of awardees + equity amounts by 2026-08-30 and upload to Drive (link below).
- Vivek: confirm payroll/cashless mechanics for the issuance by 2026-08-28.
- Maggie: prepare the DocuSign resolution and an abbreviated counsel signoff template.

Attachments: award-release-checklist.docx

Thanks all — locking in comms and candidate emails this week.

— Stephanie
